column1: # The counted-array message elision corpus over Root.schema beside this file
# ([2..3]Inner and [2..3]U). A counted array [Min..N]T elides exactly when the
# oracle's messageElides does: count 0, or count Min with every element at
# its default (a struct whose body is its terminator alone, a union at None);
# the message read refuses that same spelling stored (docs/SPEC-TABLES.md §3).
# TestRustMessageCountedBornElidesByElementDefault reads every row.
# case
# kind save: source is the value as JSON; the generated Rust writer, given the
#   rust statements on a default row v with ticks 5, writes exactly the bytes
#   the Go oracle encodes for that JSON (verdict bytes).
# kind read: source names a save row; both readers read its bytes (verdict
#   read, ticks the first field read).
# kind birth-drop-field: source names a save row whose element 0 carries one
#   struct field; that field (reference and value) is cut, so every element is
#   a body that is its terminator alone: the array is stored at its birth.
# kind birth-zero-arm: source names a save row whose element 0 is a union at
#   an arm; its arm reference is set to 0 (None) and its payload cut, so every
#   element is None: the array is stored at its birth.
# A birth row is refused as wire damage by both readers (verdict wire_damaged).
